headline.en: Granite Asia raises $500m for Pan-Asia private credit strategy
headline.zh: Granite Asia为泛亚私募信贷策略募集5亿美元

summary.en: Granite Asia has raised $500m for its Pan-Asia private credit strategy. Commitments came from DBS Private Bank, a leading insurer and other institutional investors. The strategy, Libra Hybrid, invests in mid-market companies in Asia and has completed eight transactions.
summary.zh: Granite Asia为其泛亚私募信贷策略募集了5亿美元。承诺资金来自DBS Private Bank、一家领先保险公司及其他机构投资者。该策略名为Libra Hybrid，投资于亚洲中型市场公司，并已完成八笔交易。

headline.en: BDCs take defensive approach as retail redemptions rise, Morningstar DBRS says
headline.zh: Morningstar DBRS称零售赎回增加，BDC采取防御性策略

summary.en: Morningstar DBRS said business development companies have adopted a more defensive approach in response to a challenging operating environment. The ratings agency attributed the shift to increased redemptions over the past two quarters, mostly from retail investors.
summary.zh: Morningstar DBRS表示，面对充满挑战的经营环境，业务发展公司（BDC）已采取更为防御性的策略。该评级机构将这一转变归因于过去两个季度赎回增加，且主要来自零售投资者。

headline.en: European direct lending sets half-year record despite Q2 slowdown
headline.zh: 尽管第二季度放缓，欧洲直接贷款仍创下半年纪录

summary.en: European direct lending activity slowed in the second quarter of 2026 after a dip in large transactions, according to new research. Volumes reached €28.4bn across 296 deals in the second quarter, but the region still set a half-year record for volumes.
summary.zh: 根据最新研究，在大型交易减少后，欧洲直接贷款活动在2026年第二季度放缓。第二季度成交量为284亿欧元，涉及296笔交易，但该地区仍创下半年成交量纪录。

headline.en: Nuveen raises over $1bn for fourth climate-focused property lending fund
headline.zh: Nuveen 为其第四只气候主题地产贷款基金募资逾 10 亿美元

summary.en: Nuveen Green Capital, the sustainable commercial real estate financing arm of the $1.4tn asset manager Nuveen, has raised more than $1bn for the fourth vintage of its climate-focused commercial property lending fund. The firm announced the first close of the fund.
summary.zh: Nuveen Green Capital 是规模 1.4 万亿美元资产管理公司 Nuveen 旗下提供可持续商业地产融资解决方案的机构，已为其第四只气候主题商业地产贷款基金募资超过 10 亿美元。该公司宣布了该基金的首次关闭。

headline.en: Arrow Global FUM jumps to over €15bn
headline.zh: Arrow Global 管理资产规模跃升至逾150亿欧元

summary.en: Arrow Global's funds under management rose to €15.5bn (£13.3bn) at the end of the second quarter of 2026, driven by fundraising for its credit strategy. FUM increased by €4.8bn, equivalent to 44 per cent, year-on-year.
summary.zh: 截至2026年第二季度末，Arrow Global 的管理资产规模（FUM）升至155亿欧元（133亿英镑），受其信贷策略募资推动。FUM 同比增加48亿欧元，增幅44%。
